classes.name: Election of the President of the European Parliament
classes.name_en: President of the European Parliament, elected by its members
classes.note: Elected by secret ballot for two and a half years at the start and the middle of each term; an absolute majority of votes cast is needed in the first three ballots, and a fourth is a runoff between the top two (Rules 15, 16, and 19). Acclaimed when there is only one candidate. Elected by the European Parliament in plenary by secret ballot; the Parliament's minutes and press releases give each ballot's counts.

cadence.runoff_rule: Absolute majority of votes cast in the first three ballots; the fourth is confined to the two leaders of the third.

classes.name: Election of the Vice-Presidents and Quaestors of the European Parliament
classes.name_en: Vice-Presidents and Quaestors of the European Parliament
classes.note: Fourteen Vice-Presidents on a single ballot and five Quaestors by the same procedure, right after the President and for the same two and a half years (Rules 15, 17, 18, and 19). Elected by the European Parliament in plenary by secret ballot; the Parliament's minutes and press releases give each ballot's counts.

classes.name: Election of the President of the European Commission
classes.name_en: President of the European Commission, approved and since 2009 elected by the European Parliament
classes.note: The European Council proposes a candidate and the Parliament votes on it: an approval vote under the Maastricht and Amsterdam treaties from 1994, and an election by a majority of its component members since the Lisbon Treaty (TEU art. 17(7)). Counted per vote, with yes, no, and abstentions.

classes.name: Election of the European Ombudsman
classes.name_en: European Ombudsman, elected by the European Parliament
classes.note: Elected by the Parliament after each European election for the duration of its term, renewable (TFEU art. 228(2)); the first in 1995, after the Maastricht Treaty created the office. Elected by the European Parliament in plenary by secret ballot; the Parliament's minutes and press releases give each ballot's counts.

classes.name: Designation of members of the Common Assembly and the European Parliamentary Assembly
classes.name_en: Members delegated by the national parliaments (1952-1979)
classes.disposition_reason: Before direct elections the members were designated by each national parliament from among its own members (EEC Treaty art. 138(1)); each parliament chose by its own procedure, mostly without a contested vote, and the national parliaments' records hold them.

classes.name: Election of the President of the European Council
classes.disposition_reason: Elected by the European Council, the heads of state or government, by qualified majority for two and a half years (TEU art. 15(5)); the vote is taken in closed session and no count is published.

classes.name: Consent to the College of Commissioners and motions of censure
classes.name_en: Parliament's consent vote on the Commission as a body, and motions of censure
classes.disposition_reason: Votes on the Commission as a whole (TEU art. 17(7)) and on censuring it (TFEU art. 234), not elections of a person or seat; they are roll-call votes of the Parliament.

classes.name: European citizens' initiative
classes.disposition_reason: Signature collections inviting the Commission to propose legislation (Regulation (EU) 2019/788); nobody votes on them.

classes.name: Members of the European Economic and Social Committee and the European Committee of the Regions
classes.name_en: Economic and Social Committee and Committee of the Regions
classes.disposition_reason: Appointed by the Council on member states' proposals (TFEU arts. 302 and 305), not elected.

classes.name: Referendums on European matters
classes.name_en: Referendums on European treaties and membership
classes.disposition_reason: The treaties provide for no EU-wide referendum. Referendums on accession, treaties, and withdrawal are national votes held under each member state's own law and belong to its census: class:fr/referendums, class:ie/referendums, class:it/referendums, class:gb/referendums, and class:de/volksentscheide.
